products.title: Saha Crew Sock Pack
products.body_html:
Three colors. One less decision.

The Saha Crew Sock 3-Pack includes one pair each in white, green, and black. Made from a soft cotton-rich blend with enough stretch to stay comfortable from the first tee through whatever comes after. Finished with a ribbed crew construction and embroidered Saha logo at the ankle.

  • 85% cotton, 12% polyamide, 3% elastane
  • Embroidered Saha logo

products.title: Playground Polo
products.body_html:
Built for recess. Dressed for the clubhouse.

The Playground Polo is a long-sleeve cotton polo with a relaxed silhouette, contrast collar and placket, and layered Saha artwork at the front. Finished with embroidered appliqué graphics for a more dimensional, substantial feel. Comfortable enough to play in. Proper enough to pretend otherwise.

  • 100% cotton
  • Oversize fit (Go at least a size smaller)
  • Embroidered appliqué graphics

products.title: Playfield Polo
products.body_html:
Match-day energy. Eighteen-hole comfort.

The Playfield Polo takes cues from vintage football kits and brings them onto the course. Made from a comfortable stretch blend, it features digitally printed navy-and-green stripes, a contrast-tipped ribbed collar, button placket, and multi-placement Saha graphics. Loud enough to lead the group. Easy enough to play eighteen in.

  • 87% polyester, 13% elastane
  • All-over digital print
  • Contrast-tipped ribbed collar
  • Multi-placement graphics

products.title: Lounge Polo Green
products.body_html:
Fresh out of the bag. Even better on.

The Lounge Polo is designed with a clean silhouette, a comfortable modern fit, and plenty of stretch for an unrestricted swing. Finished with a contrast-tipped ribbed collar and subtle Saha logo at the chest. Simple, sharp, and easy to wear well beyond the course.

  • 87% polyester, 13% elastane
  • Contrast-tipped ribbed collar
  • Chest logo detail

products.title: Saha Clip Towel
products.body_html:
Built to hang around.

The Saha Clip Towel keeps the essentials close with a clean, course-ready build and Saha.Golf logo detail. Finished with a metal eyelet and carabiner so it clips straight onto your bag and stays within reach when things get messy.

  • Saha.Golf logo detail
  • Metal eyelet
  • Carabiner attachment

products.title: How's My Drive Cap
products.body_html:
Bad drive. Same attitude.

The How’s My Drive Cap takes the complaint-line joke off the tee and puts it front and center. A classic six-panel cap with a curved brim and embroidered “How’s My Drive?” artwork across the front.

  • Six-panel construction
  • Curved brim
  • Embroidered front artwork

products.title: Saha Logo Cap
products.body_html:
Nothing loud. Nothing missing.

The Saha Logo Cap keeps it simple with a classic six-panel construction, curved brim, and embroidered Saha oval at the front. Easy, understated, and built to go with pretty much everything.

  • Six-panel construction
  • Curved brim
  • Embroidered Saha Logo

products.title: Pack of Tees
products.body_html:
Premium tees. Questionable packaging.

The Saha Premium Golf Tees are made from bamboo, built for the first shot, and packed like something you should probably quit. Each box contains 12 white-and-green tees featuring a 70 mm length, 10 mm cup, and Saha.Golf branding. Easy to spot, hard to quit, and best kept within reach.

  • Cigarette-style box
  • 12 Bamboo tees
  • 70 mm length
  • 10 mm cup

products.title: Locker Room Pants
products.body_html:
Proper pants. Improper range of motion.

The Locker Room Pants are woven trousers cut for a clean look with serious comfort built in. Made with a soft stretch blend, they’re sharp enough to wear out and easy enough to forget you’re wearing.

  • 62% polyester, 33% viscose, 5% elastane
  • Relaxed fit
  • Woven

products.title: Mulligan Shorts
products.body_html:
Pleats in the front. Comfort everywhere else.

The Mulligan Shorts are woven stretch shorts cut in dark navy with a clean pleated front and an easy, comfortable feel. Sharp enough to make shorts look intentional, light enough to wear all day.

  • 88% polyamide, 12% elastane
  • Relaxed fit
  • Woven

products.title: Fairway Knight Tee
products.body_html:
A gentleman’s game. Medieval consequences.

The Fairway Knight Tee brings old-world ceremony to the modern fairway. It’s cut in a relaxed fit with a classic crewneck, ribbed collar, and detailed knight artwork printed at the front.

Because the golf club is drawn in especially fine lines, it may begin to fade after repeated washes. Somewhere around the fifteenth, our golfer may finally trade the club for a sword. Consider it character development.

  • 100% cotton
  • 50+ UV Protection
  • Relaxed fit
  • Front graphic print

products.title: Aprés Golf Tee
products.body_html:
Made for after golf. Keep it between the trees.

The Après Golf Tee is inspired by the rituals that follow a round. It's cut in a relaxed fit with a classic crewneck, ribbed collar, and front graphic artwork. Clean enough for the day, loose enough for everything after.

  • 100% cotton
  • 50+ UV Protection
  • Relaxed Fit
  • Front graphic print

products.title: Slice Tee
products.body_html:
Simple from far away. Better up close.

A clean everyday tee with a little movement through it. The Slice Tee is cut in a relaxed fit with a classic crewneck, ribbed collar, and centered Saha Golfwear chest graphic. 

  • 100% cotton
  • 50+ UV Protection
  • Relaxed fit
  • Front graphic print

products.title: Burning Golf Cart Tee
products.body_html:
Human error. Still undefeated.

The Burning Golf Cart Tee is inspired by golf-course chaos, artificial intelligence, and the very human ability to take things too far. It’s cut in a relaxed fit with a classic crewneck, ribbed collar, and oversized back artwork. Clean from the front, existential from the back.

  • 100% cotton
  • 50+ UV Protection
  • Relaxed fit
  • Back graphic print

products.title: How's My Drive Tee
products.body_html:
Bad drive. Worse attitude.

The How’s My Drive Tee is inspired by roadside complaint lines and golfers who never asked for feedback. It’s cut in a relaxed fit with a classic crewneck, ribbed collar, and oversized back artwork. Clean from the front, loud from the back.

  • 100% cotton
  • 50+ UV Protection
  • Relaxed fit
  • Back graphic print
